title: Snap to Agent
tooltip.idle: Send what you see to your agent
idle.title: Send what you see to your agent
idle.body: Pick what to capture. You always get a preview before anything is sent.
capturing.title: Capturing…
capturing.body: Select an area with the mouse. Esc cancels.
question.label: What do you want help with?
context.label: Context
context.hint: This text is sent with your question. You can edit it.
masked.undo: Click one to send it unmasked
masked.reset: Undoing a mask resets your edits to the context.
hint.keys: Enter sends  ·  Ctrl+Enter copies  ·  Esc cancels
sending.title: Starting %1…
sent.title: Sent to %1
sent.body: The agent opened in its own window. It asks before it acts.
copied.title: Copied to the clipboard
note.image_path_only: This agent gets the image as a file path and the text context.
note.clipboard_paste: This agent cannot take a first prompt. It opens empty and the prompt is on the clipboard.
note.stdin_prompt: The prompt is typed into the agent as its first message.
note.generic_agent: No adapter for this agent yet. It opens as Omarchy would start it, with the prompt on the clipboard.
note.context_in_file: The context is long, so it goes in a file and the agent is told to read it.
note.agent_not_installed: This agent is not installed. Choose another in the agent setup.
error.no-default-agent.body: Choose the agent Omarchy should use, then try again.
error.clipboard-failed: Could not copy to the clipboard
error.start-failed: The agent could not be started
defaults.missing-file: Omarchy has no default agent configured.
defaults.empty: The default agent file is empty.
defaults.unreadable: The default agent setting could not be read.
pick.title: Pick a notification
pick.hint: ↑ ↓ choose  ·  Enter send to the preview  ·  Esc cancel
imagesecrets.warn: The screenshot seems to show secrets (%1). Read the preview, or send the text only, masked.
imagesecrets.textonly: Only the masked text is sent. The screenshot stays on this machine.
note.image_has_secrets: The image itself is not masked: it can show what the text masks.
note.image_not_sent: The screenshot is not sent. The agent gets the masked text.
note.ocr_missing: tesseract is not installed, so no text was read from the image. Install the tesseract package to turn this on.
error.blocked: This window is on the blocklist
error.blocked.body: Nothing was captured. You can change the blocklist in the settings file.
error.no-error-recorded.body: Install the hook once with: snap-to-agent install-hook. Then the next failed command can be sent.
error.empty-clipboard.body: Select some text, or copy something, and try again.
error.notifications-unreadable: The notification history could not be read
question.default.region: Help me with what is on my screen.
question.default.window: Help me with what is in this window.
question.default.error: Explain this error and suggest a fix.
question.default.notification: Explain this notification and tell me whether I need to act.
history.empty.title: Nothing sent yet
history.empty.body: Your last 20 sends show up here, so you can send one again.
history.hint: ↑ ↓ choose  ·  Enter send again  ·  Delete remove
settings.ocr.desc: Uses tesseract. Lets agents without image support see the text, and warns about secrets in the picture.
settings.questions.hint: Leave empty to use the built-in question.
settings.hook.on: Installed in your shell startup files.
settings.hook.confirm: This adds a marked block to ~/.bashrc (and ~/.zshrc if it exists). You can remove it here at any time.
settings.hook.done: Open a new terminal for it to take effect.
error.internal: The helper hit an unexpected error
note.auto_mode: Auto mode is on: this agent may act without asking you first. Turn it off in the settings.
settings.auto: Let the agent act without asking (auto mode)
settings.auto.desc: Off by default: agents ask before they act. On starts the agent the way Omarchy's own launcher does, with its auto-approve option where it has one. Use with care.
note.paste_prompt: The prompt is on the clipboard and the agent opens empty: paste it. This keeps the text off the command line, where other accounts on this computer could read it.
note.prompt_visible: The prompt is passed as an argument, so other accounts on this computer can read it while the agent session runs. You turned this on in the settings.
settings.promptArg: Pass the prompt to the agent as an argument
settings.promptArg.desc: Off by default: the agent opens empty and the prompt is on the clipboard for you to paste. On starts the agent with the prompt already in place, but the text is then on the agent's command line, which other local accounts can read while the session runs.
